scope: Claims under a CSS household-contents policy (AVB Ausgabe 02.2024) for theft of household contents; the Insurance Contract Act (VVG) as in force since 1 January 2024.

sources.title: Convention of this benchmark (not law): Study 4 SPEC.md item 6a

convention.text: A fact that the file does not mention is taken as not alleged, and the rules are applied as if it were absent. Silence never ends a process: where a fact's absence would end it, the unmentioned fact is unresolved. The defining event is never presumed: if the file does not mention it, it is unresolved. A fact that the file raises and leaves unsettled is open.
convention.applies_to: every branch fact (value false, applies unstated) except the defining event, a fact whose value false triggers a stop (none in this set) and a fact marked always_stated; a presumption a passage supports would take precedence (this rule set has none)

types.title: Theft at the insured location (CSS AVB Ziff. 23.3)

facts.question: Does the file state that household contents at the insured location (the Versicherungsort of the policy) were stolen or damaged by a burglary, a robbery or a simple theft (including vandalism), even if nothing was taken?
facts.not_this: Items lost, misplaced or misappropriated; a theft away from the insured location (the other claim type, Ziff. 24.2).

rule.passage: Schäden am Hausrat, auch wenn dabei nichts entwendet wurde, durch Einbruch, Beraubung und einfacher Diebstahl (inkl. Vandalismus) am Versicherungsort.

facts.question: Does the file state that the theft or damage was caused by a person who lives in the same household as the policyholder?
facts.not_this: A guest, neighbour, tradesman or cleaner, or a former household member who no longer lives there; a suspicion the file raises but does not settle is open, not true.

rule.passage: Schäden, verursacht durch Personen, die mit dem Versicherungsnehmer im gleichen Haushalt leben.

facts.question: Was the theft a burglary (the thief forcibly entered the building or a room of it, or broke open a container in it, or unlocked it with the correct keys or codes that the thief had obtained by burglary or robbery) or a robbery (theft under threat or use of violence against the policyholder or a member of the household, or while they could not resist because of unconsciousness, accident or death), and so not a simple theft?
facts.not_this: A theft through a door or window left open or unlocked, without force and without violence against a person: that is a simple theft.

rule.passage: Einfacher Diebstahl am Versicherungsort ist Diebstahl, der weder als Einbruchdiebstahl noch als Beraubung gilt.

context.passage: Einbruchdiebstahl ist Diebstahl durch Täter, die gewaltsam in ein Gebäude oder in den Raum eines Gebäudes eindringen und/oder darin ein Behältnis aufbrechen sowie Diebstahl durch Aufschliessen mit den richtigen Schlüsseln oder Codes, sofern sich der Täter diese durch Einbruchdiebstahl oder Beraubung angeeignet hat.

Beraubung ist Diebstahl unter Androhung und/oder Anwendung von Gewalt gegen den Versicherungsnehmer und die mit ihm im gleichen Haushalt lebenden Personen sowie Diebstahl bei Unfähigkeit zum Widerstand infolge Ohnmacht, Unfall oder Tod.

facts.question: Does the claim include costs of changing or replacing keys, magnetic cards or locks at the location named in the policy, or at a bank safe the policyholder rents?
facts.not_this: Emergency doors, glazing or locks put in after the event; the repair of a damaged door or window.

rule.passage: Mitversichert sind die effektiven Kosten für das Ändern oder Ersetzen von Schlüsseln, Magnetkarten oder von Schlössern an dem in der Police bezeichneten Standort und an den vom Versicherungsnehmer gemieteten Banksafes und dazugehörenden Schlüsseln.

facts.question: Does the file state that traces of the theft (for example pry marks, a broken lock, window or container) have been removed or altered, or are to be removed or altered, for example by repair or cleaning?
facts.not_this: Traces that exist and are left as they were, or were only photographed; the police examining the scene.

rule.passage: ohne Zustimmung der Polizei die Tatspuren nicht zu entfernen oder zu verändern

facts.question: Is a bicycle among the stolen or damaged items?
facts.not_this: A motor scooter or motorcycle; bicycle parts or accessories alone.

rule.passage: Fahrrad (bitte Originalkaufbelege beilegen)

facts.question: Does the file state that the original purchase vouchers for the stolen or damaged items cannot be obtained, or only at considerable cost (not even as a duplicate from the seller)?
facts.not_this: The vouchers have not been attached yet or not been looked for; finding them is merely inconvenient.

rule.passage: Der Vertrag kann verfügen: 1. dass der Anspruchsberechtigte bestimmte Belege, deren Beschaffung ihm ohne erhebliche Kosten möglich ist, insbesondere auch ärztliche Bescheinigungen, beizubringen hat;
rule.inference: The contract may require only vouchers whose procurement is possible without considerable cost; a voucher that cannot be obtained, or only at considerable cost, is outside what the contract may require.

facts.question: Does the file state that measures to reduce the loss are or were to be taken after the theft, and that there was no imminent danger (Gefahr im Verzug) requiring them before the insurer could be asked?
facts.not_this: Measures that had to be taken at once because of imminent danger; the notification of the claim itself; steps to find the thief or recover the items.

rule.passage: Der Anspruchsberechtigte ist verpflichtet, nach Eintritt des befürchteten Ereignisses tunlichst für Minderung des Schadens zu sorgen. Er muss, wenn nicht Gefahr im Verzug liegt, über die zu ergreifenden Massnahmen die Weisung des Versicherungsunternehmens einholen und befolgen.

rule.inference: The clause covers the effective cost of the change, and the claimant must prove the amount (Ziff. 29 lit. a); the invoice of the locksmith or supplier is the document that ordinarily shows that cost. Costs after a simple theft are excluded (Ziff. 20 lit. d, Ausschluss), so the invoice is needed only after a burglary or robbery.

types.title: Simple theft away from the insured location (CSS AVB Ziff. 24.2)

facts.question: Does the file state that household contents were stolen outside the insured location, in a theft that was neither a burglary (the thief forcibly entered the building or a room of it, or broke open a container in it, or unlocked it with the correct keys or codes that the thief had obtained by burglary or robbery) or a robbery (theft under threat or use of violence against the policyholder or a member of the household, or while they could not resist because of unconsciousness, accident or death)?
facts.not_this: A theft at the insured location (the other claim type, Ziff. 23.3); items lost, left behind or misplaced.

rule.passage: Schäden am Hausrat durch Diebstahl, der weder als Einbruchdiebstahl noch als Beraubung gilt und sich ausserhalb des versicherten Standortes ereignet, sind bis zu der in der Police vereinbarten Versicherungssumme mitversichert.

facts.question: Does the file state that the policy does not include the separate supplementary insurance for simple theft away from home (einfacher Diebstahl auswärts)?
facts.not_this: Another supplementary cover being missing; the claimant being unsure whether the cover exists (that is open).

rule.passage: Für den einfachen Diebstahl auswärts ist eine separate Zusatzversicherung abzuschliessen.
